summaryZh: Botta Lab研究胃肠道和胰腺癌生长与转移的机制，以胰腺癌为模型开发调控肿瘤免疫和代谢过程的肽。实验室结合患者肿瘤单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组、三维体外模型及遗传工程小鼠模型研究治疗靶向。
researchQuestions: 胃肠道及胰腺癌生长和转移的机制是什么？
如何用肽调控肿瘤免疫与代谢过程以开发治疗？
topics: 肿瘤免疫代谢与肽治疗开发

evidence.quote: The Botta Lab - UCSD Moores Cancer Center
A translational oncology & regenerative medicine laboratory dedicated to research on pancreatic cancer lead by Gregory Botta,
Dr. Botta's laboratory is broadly dedicated to understanding the mechanisms of gastrointestinal & pancreatic cancer growth and metastasis.

Using pancreatic cancer as a model, we develop small proteins (peptides) to hijack tumor immune and metabolic processes for drug development, novel combinations and drug repurposing to reduce toxicity.
Our single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics protocols are designed to characterize individual cells from patient tumor samples.
We utilize 3D in vitro and in vivo genetically engineered mouse models to effectively target cancer through peptide delivery of therapeutics.
